interest: Shows wartime views on Japan's alien land law via Swiss reports, tied to an Oregon land-board inquiry.
overview: Memo (1943): Oregon's land board prompts review of whether Japan's 1926 Alien Land Law still applies in wartime; Swiss reports say American inheritance rights are unchanged outside defense zones. Includes a 1984 withdrawal notice for a classified document.

people.name: D. W. Smith
people.role: Drafter, Special Division, Department of State

subfiles.about: Internal memorandum discussing the ongoing validity of Japan's 1926 Alien Land Law and American inheritance rights in wartime Japan.
subfiles.from: Special Division, Department of State (D. W. Smith)
subfiles.summary: Memo: Swiss reports say Japan's 1926 Alien Land Law still lets Americans inherit property outside defense zones.
subfiles.title: Memorandum from Special Division on Alien Real Property and Inheritance Rights in Japan
